title: He Turned Down $20 Million a Year
description:
He turned down 20 million dollars a year. To stay.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Faker (gamer): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faker_(gamer)

From Wikipedia (Faker (gamer)): Lee Sang-hyeok, known as Faker, was signed by SK Telecom T1 in 2013 at 17 and won the LCK and the World Championship in his debut year; he is a six-time world champion (2013, 2015, 2016, 2023-2025) and the first player to win three consecutive Worlds titles; he re-signed in the 2015 offseason despite offers of nearly US$1,000,000 from Chinese companies (reported November 2014); before the 2022 season a Chinese team offered him US$20,000,000 per year, according to T1's CEO, and he stayed with T1; he became a part-owner of T1 in 2020, and his salary as of 2020 was estimated at nearly US$5 million. Not financial advice.

loop: So next time someone says loyalty doesn't pay, remember:
cta: Stay or take the money? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: He turned down 20 million dollars a year. To stay.
He's Faker. Six-time League of Legends world champion.
He went pro at 17. Then won the world title that same year.
Instead, he stayed for about 5 million a year. Plus part of the team.
Then three world titles in a row. The first player ever.
